Hi Samira — Neha here, Solutions Engineer on the GitHub integration. 11:00 AM PT tomorrow works for us and I’ll join the call.

Answering your questions up-front:
- Minimal GitHub App scopes we recommend for a minimal-demo install:
  • Repository contents: read (for reading workflows/templates)
  • Actions: read + write (to allow interaction with workflow runs if you want to invoke inference from a job)
  • Pull requests: read
  • Metadata: read
  • Checks: read + write (optional, for status updates)

- Org SAML / SSO: SAML itself does not block App installs, but GitHub org settings can require org-admin approval for third-party apps. The typical path is: request approval from your org admin with the App manifest link (we can provide a short note you can paste into that request).

Quick notes for the call:
- If you plan to use self-hosted runners that need to reach a private Redwood deployment, we’ll discuss network options (VPC egress / NAT) during the demo.
- For a friction-free demo, prepare one repo and an org admin contact (or provide a temp admin approval).

I have attached the pre-demo checklist and will send a calendar invite for Tue 2026-09-16 11:00 AM PT. See you there.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
